summary: Ch.1: Office worker Mikura Makoto, a people-pleaser who hides his love of shoujo manga, bumps into a strikingly handsome blond security guard and picks up the rabbit keychain he dropped. Assuming it's a girlfriend's gift, he returns it on Monday; that evening the guard, Futagami Toki (a university student), invites him to dinner as thanks. Toki reveals the plush is his own hobby, 'second only to my life', and asks if Mikura finds it weird; Mikura says having something you love is wonderful. Mikura lets slip that he likes shoujo manga too, then tries to deny it, but Toki says hearing it made him happy and asks Mikura to become 'that kind of relationship' with him. To be continued.

Ch.2: Toki's 'that kind of relationship' turns out to mean fellow fans. Mikura over-plans their outing with a researched itinerary; Toki is touched. At the mascot shop Mikura draws the first-prize giant rabbit plush for him; at a collab family restaurant Mikura envies how openly Toki enjoys his hobby. Toki plans to visit Mikura's flat next so he can be shown his favourite manga. At a bookshop Toki buys two copies of Mikura's favourite author's new shoujo manga - one as thanks, one for himself - saying he's interested in whatever Mikura likes. Mikura wonders why his heart is racing.

Ch.3: Mikura realises he has fallen for Toki and, afraid, avoids him for over a week; distracted, he makes a costly mistake at work. Toki waits for him after hours, asks if he is the cause, and Mikura breaks down crying. He explains he was mocked for his hobby as a teenager and has hidden himself ever since; Toki says their relationship is theirs to decide and asks him to talk to him. On the train they meet Toki's ex Misa, who sneers at the matching rabbit plushes; Mikura stands up for Toki's hobby. On the platform he confesses: 'I like you, Toki.' To be continued.

Ch.4 (Toki's POV): After Mikura confesses that he likes Toki romantically, Toki leaves abruptly, assuming it is only about his looks like everyone else. His friends mock his failed relationships and say he never understood one-sided love. Recalling how Mikura saw him for who he was, Toki realises he wants to know him better, but Mikura acts normal and never contacts him. Seeing Mikura with coworker Sato, Toki panics, but she announces she is marrying Takada; Toki flees. Sato encourages Mikura to talk things through. That night Sato calls Toki to collect a drunk Mikura, who keeps calling his name; Toki brings him home, realising he has fallen for him, and asks to talk in the morning.

Ch.5 (final): Mikura wakes at Toki's flat after being carried home drunk. Toki explains he got angry because past partners only saw his looks, but now thinks only of Mikura; he confesses and asks him out. They admit to tiptoeing like first-loves, try to be intimate but Mikura is too drunk, and agree to take time. Sato congratulates Mikura. On a winter date Toki says he now understands shoujo manga; Mikura thanks him for helping him learn to say what he feels, and Toki shouts that he loves him.
